title: Multi-Objective Ranking for Live-Streaming: Balancing Fresh and Delayed Signals with Segment-Aware Targeting
title_zh: 面向直播推荐的多目标排序：用分段感知目标平衡即时与延迟信号
abstract_en: One of the most challenging problems entertainment live-streaming services face in recommendation systems is that user behaviors are sparse and delayed, and interaction data exhibits bias for different user segments. Unlike e-commerce applications where user actions follow linear sequences, live-streaming viewers engage in multiple concurrent behaviors of watching, chatting, following, and spending, each occurring with varying delays. We address these challenges through three key contributions: 1) a delayed window approach that extends feedback collection beyond immediate responses, 2) a multi-model architecture that combines fresh and delayed signals, and a segment-aware targeting module that optimizes ranking scores differently across user lifecycle stages, and 3) Multi-gate Mixture-of-Experts (MMoE) integration that jointly models correlated targets while reducing model parameters by 41.9% compared to independent models. Online A/B testing demonstrates significant improvements, including a +0.09% increase in Daily Active Viewers (DAV), generating millions more annual active viewer days, and +0.56% increase in highly engaged viewers' capped Average Revenue Per User (ARPU). Viewer-segment targeting achieved an additional +0.15% DAV improvement for newer and less engaged viewers, while MMoE enhancement added +0.08% overall DAV and +0.27% new follows. The proposed system processes ranking requests with low latency, providing a scalable approach for balancing multiple business objectives across diverse user populations. In addition, we tested the multi-model architecture on the Twitch mobile live feed and achieved a +1.12% increase in positive user-channel interactions (clicks, follows, and likes), demonstrating applicability beyond the primary use case.
abstract_zh: 本文针对娱乐直播推荐中的稀疏、延迟反馈以及不同用户分群的数据偏差问题，提出一套可扩展的多目标排序系统。不同于电商场景中较线性的用户行为，直播用户会并行产生观看、聊天、关注、消费等多类行为，且反馈延迟各不相同。论文的核心方案包括：通过 delayed window 扩展反馈收集窗口，捕获即时响应之外的延迟行为；采用 multi-model architecture 融合 fresh signals 与 delayed signals；引入 segment-aware targeting module，根据用户生命周期阶段差异化优化排序分数；并集成 Multi-gate Mixture-of-Experts（MMoE）联合建模相关目标，相比独立模型减少 41.9% 参数量。在线 A/B 测试显示，该系统带来 +0.09% Daily Active Viewers（DAV）提升，对高参与用户的 capped ARPU 提升 +0.56%；面向新用户和低参与用户的分群目标优化额外带来 +0.15% DAV；MMoE 进一步贡献 +0.08% 整体 DAV 和 +0.27% 新关注数增长。系统在低延迟下处理排序请求，并在 Twitch mobile live feed 上验证了泛化性，使正向用户-频道交互（点击、关注、点赞）提升 +1.12%。
key_points_zh: 提出 delayed window 方法，将反馈收集从即时行为扩展到延迟行为，更适配直播中观看、聊天、关注、消费等多并发且不同延迟的互动模式。
设计融合 fresh signals 与 delayed signals 的 multi-model architecture，并通过 segment-aware targeting module 针对不同用户生命周期阶段差异化优化排序目标。
引入 MMoE 联合建模多个相关目标，在减少 41.9% 参数量的同时保持多目标建模能力，降低相较独立模型的部署成本。
在线 A/B 测试显示系统带来 +0.09% DAV、+0.56% 高参与用户 capped ARPU；分群目标优化额外提升新用户和低参与用户 DAV +0.15%。
在 Twitch mobile live feed 上迁移验证，正向用户-频道交互（点击、关注、点赞）提升 +1.12%，表明方法具备跨场景适用性。

llm_assessment.comment: A solid live-streaming ranking system paper, but its domain grounding is entertainment recommendation rather than e-commerce agents or shopping workflows.
llm_assessment.comment_zh: 这是一篇扎实的直播排序系统论文，但其领域核心是娱乐推荐，而不是电商智能体或购物流程。
